title: Aufmerksamkeit
slide_intent: Use a small gesture to attract attention without forcing someone to reread a symbol.
strategic_value: A brief receiver wobble can give DB controls expression while retaining a familiar telephone silhouette.
demonstration: A dark outline telephone receiver tilts and returns to rest against a pale field.
practical_value: Use a local rotational gesture for attention when the icon itself need not change meaning.

content_islands.name: Attention gesture
content_islands.spec: Place the receiver alone in the field and rotate it briefly.

content_islands.name: Rest
content_islands.spec: Return the receiver to its original orientation.
